confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader markdown/figure images, pypdf fallback snippets, rendered methods pages, PubMed/Crossref routes, and Elsevier predictable supplement paths were checked. The paper reports the static left/right pink-noise bursts, speaker and hand geometry, electrical tactile waveform, simultaneous congruent audio-tactile timing, posture blocks, random trial order, ISI range, response mapping, and trial counts. The Elsevier mmc1 JPG is a supporting/results image and does not add methods parameters.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The task can be recreated as a static left/right lateralization profile with auditory-only, tactile-only, and congruent audio-tactile rows in crossed and uncrossed posture blocks. It should not be treated as a looming/receding PPS trajectory because the auditory sources are fixed speakers beside the hands.

orientation_ledger.participant_frame: Participants sat blindfolded with head restrained by a chin rest, hands palm-down 30 cm in front of the body and 25 cm left/right of body midline.
orientation_ledger.room_apparatus_frame: Two physical stereo speakers were immediately beside the left and right hands, also 25 cm to either side of body midline; Figure 1 is a top-view schematic.
orientation_ledger.body_relative_mapping: Sources were external left/right hemispaces. Uncrossed posture matched anatomical and external side; crossed posture swapped hand side but responses stayed tied to external side.
orientation_ledger.tactile_anchor: Ring electrodes stimulated the middle finger of each hand around proximal and distal interphalangeal joints.
orientation_ledger.movement_implementation: No auditory motion was used; the manipulation was static external side plus crossed/uncrossed hand posture.
orientation_ledger.evidence_class: Main-text procedure, Figure 1 caption/image, OpenDataLoader extracted figure image, and rendered PDF pages 2-3.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-3 for Methods, Stimuli, Procedure, Figure 1, response mapping, ISI, blocks, practice trials, and analysis window.
Used as the primary text map for stimulus, apparatus, tactile, sequence, baseline, count, and race-model searches.
Visual inspection of Figure 1 top-view setup for uncrossed/crossed posture, hand spacing, speaker side, external-side response mapping, and condition icons.
Targeted snippets from pages 1-3 verified title/authors, auditory/tactile stimulus parameters, procedure, response mapping, counts, ISI, blocks, and scoring window.
Temporary rendered pages were inspected for Methods text, Figure 1 geometry/caption, and the trial-count paragraph; page images were not committed.

Web, Crossref, PubMed, and Elsevier predictable mmc1 document/archive/PDF paths were checked. A supporting/results JPG exists but contains performance plots rather than hidden stimulus or timing methods.

review_attempts.result: Automated candidates covered only 6/25 fields, so the methods pages and figure were reviewed manually.
Confirmed 100 ms Adobe Audition 2.0 pink-noise bursts, 90 ms plateau, 5 ms rise/fall, 75 dB SPL, and fixed left/right Gigaworks T20 speakers.
Rendered pages and inspected Figure 1; recorded top-view participant frame, left/right speaker placement, crossed/uncrossed hand mapping, and no-motion status.
Confirmed five 1 ms biphasic pulses every 25 ms, 40 Hz/100 ms, simultaneous congruent audio-tactile trials, and unimodal rows as race-model comparison baselines.
Confirmed randomized trials within each posture block, crossed/uncrossed blocks counterbalanced, mean ISI 1950 ms with 1200-2700 ms range, and 21 practice trials before each block.
Confirmed 300 test stimuli per posture: 2 sides x 3 modalities x 50, two posture blocks, 600 total test stimuli, no catch/no-go trials, and omission rejection.
PubMed/Crossref/source routes and Elsevier mmc1 document/archive/PDF probes found no methods supplement; the available mmc1 JPG is only a supporting/results figure.

stimulus_type.value: Auditory stimuli were 100 ms pink-noise bursts.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The sound class and duration are explicitly reported.

source_provenance.value: Pink-noise bursts were produced with Adobe Audition 2.0; no original WAV, seed, or full recipe is supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Software provenance is reported; exact asset provenance remains incomplete.

trajectory_count.value: Two static auditory source sides: left external hemispace and right external hemispace.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The task varies external side, not motion trajectory.

trajectory_path.value: Static left/right speakers were immediately beside the hands, 25 cm left/right of body midline; hands were 30 cm in front of the body and 50 cm apart.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Text reports distances; Figure 1 confirms the top-view left/right static layout.

stimulus_duration.value: Auditory bursts lasted 100 ms, with 90 ms plateau and 5 ms rise/fall ramps.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration and envelope timing are stated together.

stimulus_speed.value: No looming, receding, moving, or apparent-motion auditory trajectory was used.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: This is a static lateralization task.

auditory_conditions.value: Auditory-only left/right, tactile-only left/right, and congruent audio-tactile left/right conditions were used in both posture blocks.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The 2 sides x 3 condition formula and congruent bimodal rule are reported.

gain_envelope.value: Pink-noise bursts had 90% normalized peak value, 90 ms plateau, 5 ms rise/fall, and 75 dB SPL in both channels.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Amplitude/envelope and SPL are explicitly reported.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Stereo speakers were Gigaworks T20 units; stimuli/RTs were controlled by Presentation on a Dell XPS Windows XP computer.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Speaker model and control software/computer are reported.

trial_rows_families.value: Rows were auditory-only, tactile-only, and congruent bimodal audio-tactile trials, each on left or right side.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The paper gives the side x condition x repetition design formula.

condition_intermixing.value: Within each posture block, left/right auditory, tactile, and bimodal stimuli were randomly presented.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Random presentation applies to the full 2 x 3 trial set within posture.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Uncrossed and crossed postures were separate blocks; posture order was counterbalanced across subjects.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Posture is blocked; trial rows inside each posture block are random.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Mean interstimulus interval was 1950 ms, with a 1200-2700 ms range.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The paper reports the ISI mean and range, but not distribution shape.

response_window.value: Participants responded as quickly/accurately as possible; analysis used RTs from 150-1000 ms post-stimulus for inverse efficiency scores.
response_window.evidence_note: Online timeout is not stated; scoring window is reported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Responses were by external left/right side; in crossed posture the responding hand swapped anatomically but still pressed the key for the external stimulus side.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: This external-side rule is critical for crossed-hand recreation.

tactile_stimulus.value: Each tactile stimulus was five 1 ms biphasic square pulses every 25 ms, 40 Hz for 100 ms, delivered by ring electrodes on the middle finger of each hand.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Waveform, pulse count, frequency/duration, site, and electrodes are reported.

soa_table.value: Bimodal audio-tactile trials were simultaneous and congruent, so the audio-tactile SOA was 0 ms for left and right bimodal rows.
soa_table.evidence_note: The paper states simultaneous presentation for bimodal stimuli.

baseline_strategy.value: Unimodal auditory-only and tactile-only rows served as race-model/comparison baselines; there was no looming PPS distance/SOA baseline ladder.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, Stimuli and Race Model analysis
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Race-model bounds are computed from auditory-alone and tactile-alone conditions.

baseline_timing.value: Unimodal baseline/comparison rows used the same 100 ms auditory or tactile event duration; no separate baseline SOA offsets were used.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: There is no T1-Tn or near/far timing ladder in this static task.

catch_trial_type.value: No catch/no-go trials are reported; missed responses were omissions and rejected.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: All reported test rows were auditory, tactile, or bimodal lateralization trials.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Per posture block: 50 repetitions for each side x modality row, including 50 bimodal SOA=0 trials per side.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The design formula reports 2 sides x 3 conditions x 50 stimuli.

baseline_count.value: Per posture block, unimodal comparison rows comprised 100 auditory-only trials and 100 tactile-only trials: 50 per side for each modality.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Counts follow directly from the side x condition x repetition formula.

catch_count.evidence_note: The task contains no sound-only no-go or tactile-absent catch family.

block_count.value: Two test blocks were used, one uncrossed and one crossed posture, each about 10 minutes, with a 10-minute pause between blocks.
block_count.evidence_note: Posture blocks and pause duration are reported.

total_trial_count.value: 300 test stimuli per posture block and 600 total test stimuli per participant, plus 21 practice trials before each block.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: The per-posture total is explicit; total follows from two posture blocks.

critical_caveats: The local record ID/citation label says Tajadura-Jimenez, but the PDF and DOI are Collignon et al. (2009). Preserve the record ID for continuity and cite the actual paper in review notes.
This is a static left/right lateralization task, not a dynamic looming or receding PPS trajectory.
The exact pink-noise file, random seed, and full spectral recipe are not supplied beyond Adobe Audition 2.0 production and envelope/SPL settings.
The online response timeout is not reported; only the 150-1000 ms post-stimulus analysis window is reported.
ISI mean and range are reported, but the exact jitter distribution is not.
The supporting mmc1 JPG contains results plots, not hidden apparatus/stimulus methods.
next_manual_action: Treat this as a high-confidence static external-left/right crossed-hands lateralization template candidate. Do not use it as a looming profile; if templated, preserve the external-side response mapping and posture block factor.
